description: Build an ATS-safe resume from a career file, score it against a job blueprint with six simulated vendor parsers, and fail the job when a vendor falls below its floor, a knockout fails, or the document carries hidden text. Scores are a simulated parse and keyword risk, not a vendor's own result.

inputs.description: build (render only), score (score an existing resume) or gate (build, then score the PDF it rendered).
inputs.name: mode

inputs.description: score: the PDF or DOCX to score.
inputs.name: resume

inputs.description: build, gate: the career JSON file.
inputs.name: career

inputs.description: build, gate: the tailoring YAML file.
inputs.name: tailoring

inputs.description: build, gate: public, or a private contact JSON file.
inputs.name: contact

inputs.description: build, gate: the directory the resume, partials and manifest are written to.
inputs.name: out

inputs.description: build, gate: true to allow a private contact file in CI, where it would otherwise be refused.
inputs.name: allow-private-contact

inputs.description: score, gate: builtin:ID, a blueprint file, an https:// URL, or generate:FILE-OR-URL (a job posting).
inputs.name: blueprint

inputs.description: score, gate: floor overrides such as "taleo=80, lever=0". Empty keeps the documented default floors.
inputs.name: floors

inputs.description: score, gate: true or false. Whether hidden or metadata-only text fails the gate.
inputs.name: fail-on-integrity-flags

inputs.description: score, gate: the JSON report path (must end in .json); the markdown summary is written beside it as .md.
inputs.name: report

outputs.description: The verdict as compact JSON: passed, reasons, and each vendor's score and floor.
outputs.name: score-json

outputs.description: The lowest of the six vendor scores.
outputs.name: min-vendor-score

outputs.description: build, gate: the directory of HTML partials.
outputs.name: partials-dir

outputs.description: score, gate: the JSON report path.
outputs.name: report-json

outputs.description: score, gate: the sha256 of the exact file that was scored.
outputs.name: resume-sha256
